report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency issues, but current telemetry is largely healthy: gateway error_rate 0.0012, p95 78ms, INFO 200 logs; order checkout trace OK at 1650ms with error_rate 0.0012. Order shows retained heap after GC (340MB, WARN logs), but a single snapshot cannot establish a leak, and no evidence ties it to latency or errors. Deployment record alone cannot establish causation. Insufficient evidence for a bounded candidate; hand off.
missing_evidence: Traces showing order checkout errors or elevated latency aligned with the alert window
Gateway error-rate/latency metrics corroborating the alert (current metrics show 0.0012 error rate, p95 78ms)
Memory-retention time series for order to establish a leak trend rather than a single snapshot
Evidence linking order retained heap to checkout latency or errors
